task_completion.description: Navigate to the 'Calendar Year and Period' window in iDempiere.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The window title or breadcrumbs show 'Calendar Year and Period' or 'Year' window.

task_completion.description: Locate and select the 'Standard' calendar record.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Calendar' field or record list shows 'Standard' as the active or selected calendar.

task_completion.description: Create a new Year record with Name and Fiscal Year set to '2030'.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A record in the 'Year' tab shows '2030' in both the 'Year' and 'Fiscal Year' fields.

task_completion.description: Click the 'Create Periods' button to initiate period generation.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The cursor clicking the 'Create Periods' button or a process dialog box appearing for period creation.

task_completion.description: Verify that 12 monthly accounting periods have been generated for the year 2030.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Period' tab or sub-grid shows 12 distinct rows, typically named January through December or 01-2030 through 12-2030.

integrity.description: The agent used the iDempiere web interface rather than database scripts or terminal commands.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show mouse movements, clicks, and form entries within the browser-based GUI.

integrity.description: The agent manually entered '2030' into the fields rather than it being pre-populated by a script.
integrity.visual_evidence: Sequential screenshots showing the '2030' text appearing in the input fields during the session.

integrity.description: The agent navigated through the application menus or search bar to find the correct window.
integrity.visual_evidence: The menu tree or the 'Search' bar being used to locate 'Calendar Year and Period'.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The target year is 2030. The calendar name must be 'Standard'. The 'Create Periods' process in iDempiere is a standard function that, when triggered for a year, must generate exactly 12 monthly periods. Verification is successful only if the 'Year' record is saved and the 'Period' sub-tab contains 12 entries.
